paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (users, templates, workspaces, audit logs), the Terraform cache in coder/, and the database password in state/. Back up this folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Coder web UI, API, web terminals and workspace connections, published on host as 6145

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open Coder at. Change localhost to your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6145, or use your own HTTPS domain like https://coder.example.com. Workspaces connect back to Coder at this address, so it must work from other devices.
